order_note: No predecessor (as SQL 120 for SQL 98): the spec prerequisites are the file's own, SQL 120's trigger function public.aws_record_checkalt_billing_event() among them (the file refuses without it, 55000 sql152_prerequisite_missing), and SQL 120 is applied in staging and production. SQL 152 replaces SQL 149, never applied and given no spec or pin: SQL 149 created public.tenant_usage_fee_launch and revoked only PUBLIC, so the table would have kept the grants the database's default privileges give a new table (SQL 117's staging failure, run 40434533070); SQL 152 is SQL 149 plus SQL 118's revoke of every non-owner grant on that table. New objects: the one-row table public.tenant_usage_fee_launch (RLS on, no policy, no grant to anyone), the functions aws_usage_fee_launched_at(), aws_invoice_fee_cents() (30), aws_failed_deposit_fee_cents() (200), aws_record_invoice_fee() and aws_record_failed_deposit_fee() (EXECUTE for the owner only), the triggers aws_moov_invoice_fee (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF sent_at ON moov_invoices) and aws_checkalt_deposit_failed_fee (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON checkalt_deposits), the partial unique index check_billing_events_usage_source_uidx and four integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 columns on tenant_maintenance_payments (invoice_fee_count, invoice_fee_amount_cents, failed_deposit_count, failed_deposit_amount_cents). The applying login must own every altered relation (altered_relations_owned_by_login) and reach check_billing_events as the trigger functions' owner past RLS (definer_can_write_relations). Expected pre-state in both environments: none of SQL 152's objects present (release sql152 v1, everything absent: 99c391367eaf941dae2a89cf78d72ae87fff5559d2fc3c26ad7acc691f1a4a5e, releaseStateHash('sql152', {})). The API members that read the new events (tenant-fee-invoice-email.mjs, held on SQL 152, and tenant-billing-engine.mjs, held on SQL 151, which needs SQL 152) reach production only through the guarded Lambda overlay after this apply; the Settings -> Usage change ships through the guarded SPA path. No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. SQL 151 (the Starter Package) must not be applied before SQL 152.
